about_the_game:
Microverse In Box: A god-like sandbox where large language models put you in control—including the very fabric of society itself.

Every NPC breathes with AI-driven thoughts and actions, their behaviors bending to the rules you set. Want a world where generosity is currency? Dictate it. Prefer a society governed by ancient rituals? Forge those laws. From moral codes to power hierarchies, from resource distribution to conflict resolution—you define what “order” (or chaos) looks like here.

Use APIs or local Ollama to fuel this intelligence, then refine it all with cards: tweak personas to fit your norms, adjust wealth systems to enforce your rules, shift relationships to reflect your social structures. Every choice—big or small—ripples through the narrative, because the stories unfold not just around your actions, but because of the society you built.

No limits. No prewritten scripts. Just endless possibilities to craft the social universe you’ve imagined.
